"""
Full material property payload exposed through the SDK. Groups the per-face stacks (Front/Back/Side)
with the physical-property settings so an entire material can be read or written in one call.

is carried inside this struct so the get/set signatures stay symmetric.

front:MaterialFaceOptions                         # front face material; also used for buttons, threads and single-faced objects such as graphics and trims
back:MaterialFaceOptions                          # back face material; used when contextOptions.targetComponent is COMPONENT_BACK
side:MaterialFaceOptions                          # side face material; used when contextOptions.targetComponent is COMPONENT_SIDE
physical_type:str                                 # Physical property type (e.g. "Fabric"). Default "Fabric".
physical_preset:str                               # Physical property preset name. Default "Custom".
physical_thickness_mm:float                       # Physical thickness in millimeters. Default 0.

                                                  # COMPONENT_BUTTON / COMPONENT_THREAD / COMPONENT_NONE have no face and return nullptr.

"""
The sub-component tab a material operation targets. Fabric objects expose Front/Back/Side; Button
objects expose Button/Thread; Graphics and Avatars have no tabs (COMPONENT_NONE).
"""
COMPONENT_FRONT = 0   # Fabric front face
COMPONENT_BACK = 1    # Fabric back face
COMPONENT_SIDE = 2    # Fabric side face
COMPONENT_BUTTON = 3  # Button body
COMPONENT_THREAD = 4  # Button thread
COMPONENT_NONE = -1   # Graphics, Avatar (no component tabs)
records.description_raw:
